Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Product].[Non-Consumable].[Other] AS 'Sum(Except( [Product].[Product Department].Members, TopCount([Product].[Product Department].Members, 3)), Measures.[Unit Sales])' SELECT { [Measures].[Unit Sales] } ON COLUMNS, { TopCount([Product].[Product Department].Members,3), [Product].[Non-Consumable].[Other] } ON ROWS from [ZFMSALES]
